evidence.claim: Lint and format are configured (eslint flat config + prettier) and enforced both in CI (via check) and pre-commit via husky + lint-staged on staged files.
The repo carries two cross-linked ADRs with a decisions index, documenting the persistence contract and the referential-integrity rule before implementation.
A committed Plan Artifact records the implementation plan, the Reuse & Prior Art check, and the pre-implementation plan-auditor verdict (Proceed after minor edits).
Commit history is conventional and intent-bearing, with issue references (feat/docs/chore, '#9'), reflecting a tracked lifecycle rather than dump commits.
Dependency hygiene is automated: dependabot groups npm + github-actions updates weekly against the dev branch.

strengths.point: The full Dynamo lifecycle is evidenced in-repo: plan + plan-audit + ADRs + conventional commits + .dynamo.json bindings, an unusually complete discipline trail for an MVP.
eslint config documents WHY each project-wide rule override exists (config-driven navigation, vendored ui/ ignore), so the lint posture is intentional and explained.

risks.point: README has drifted from the working tree: its Project Structure and Auth Architecture sections describe hooks.server.ts, login/, auth/callback/, and a /styleguide route that no longer exist after the auth shell was removed.
No CHANGELOG.md or KNOWN-ISSUES.md present, though acceptable for a pre-release template with no tagged versions.

up_one.condition: Already at ceiling: ADRs + plan + lint-in-CI + automated dep updates + usable commit history all present.

down_one.condition: Stop enforcing format/lint in the pre-commit chain or remove the ADRs/plan trail.

conventional-commit-style.claim: Recent commits follow the Dynamo conventional-commit taxonomy (feat/docs/chore) with issue references and meaningful subjects; no wip/misc dump commits.

no-changelog.claim: No CHANGELOG.md or KNOWN-ISSUES.md exists at the repo root in this snapshot.
